title: The Hat-Trick — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational cricket philosophy 106bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal Spanish French language learning
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The hat-trick is three wickets from three consecutive deliveries
A thing so rare it stops the whole ground and all its memories
The first one is a wicket — good bowling, move along
The second raises eyebrows and the crowd begins its song

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
El hat-trick: tres bateadores en tres lanzamientos seguidos
[The hat-trick: three batsmen in three consecutive deliveries]
Un logro tan raro que deja a todos sin sonidos
[An achievement so rare it leaves everyone without sound]
La primera pelota cae — bien, sigue adelante
[The first ball falls — good, keep going]
La segunda levanta cejas — el terreno está vibrante
[The second raises eyebrows — the ground is vibrating]

[Chorus — English]
The hat-trick is the rarest thing the cricket ground will see
Three balls, three wickets, a moment that will live in history
The hat-trick takes a lifetime and three seconds to complete
And no one who achieves it ever thinks the job is neat
That's my boy

[Bridge — French, with English translation]
Le hat-trick arrive une fois dans une carrière — peut-être
[The hat-trick arrives once in a career — maybe]
Trois guichets consécutifs — l'impossible peut-être
[Three consecutive wickets — the impossible perhaps]
La foule se lève, le terrain tremble sous les pieds
[The crowd rises, the ground trembles underfoot]
Le hat-trick est le moment où le cricket est complet
[The hat-trick is the moment when cricket is complete]

[Outro — All three languages]
Hat-trick knows… Hat-trick sabe… Le hat-trick sait
Three in a row — Tres seguidos — Trois de suite
That's my boy
